_doc: Drive 9 whole-character round 3: render-time model and pose edits (d9_blender.py --r2 <this file>, r2_blender.py). Round 2's edits (r2_model.json) are carried over whole, and round 3's are added on top. Nothing is baked into lanes/drive9.blend or rosace.blend and the pose files are never edited: 'poses' is deep-merged over each pose (after drape p5) by pose name. Each value's reason is in 'why'.

why.tabard: Critics (first impression, body, outfit): the pelvis read as one skin block with a 1 px string ('bottomless'), and the thin pointed tabard read as a sword. The design's front tabard is meant to cover the front (DESIGN table: 'covers the front, main flag'): widened x1.3 at the waist to x1.65 at the hem (a flare, silhouette mass) and hung straight (idle tabard g 1.0, no side wind), so it covers the crotch at 144 and 80.
why.circlet: Critic (head and hair): 'no signature priestess head piece; the side beads are tiny; add a gold circlet, rosace pin or short veil that reads at 80'. A gold front diadem on the hair's own contour at the brow (front 1.775 m, back 1.845 m, 160 deg arc whose ends sink into the hair) with a glass rosace jewel at the centre. A full ring read as a hat brim; a band 0.02 m tall drew as outline only.
why.idle: Pose angles +30 % over the figure-pose lane's concept A (ESCALATION 1): hip rotation 5/15/4 -> 6.5/19.5/5.2, torso bend -12/-5 -> -15.6/-6.5, upper chest lift 6 -> 8, head tilt 12 -> 16 and chin 7 -> 10 (critic: 'tilt 6-8 deg chin down, knowing look'). The near bell sleeve is scaled 0.78 and blown back (g 0.5) so the waist-to-hip curve breaks the silhouette (critic: 'clear the sleeve off the hip'). The free knee's pole moves out-forward (the stance note: 'idle knees cross inward').
why.back: Critic: 'not a back view: a near-frontal face'. The look amount 1.0 -> 0.62 with max 85 -> 60: the head turns over the shoulder to three-quarter (head facing the camera 0.78 -> 0.44), and d9_post draws one profile eye when the far eye faces away (r2_faces.json profile_below).
why.q: Critic (first impression): 'the q crouch reads as a broken hip / a fall at 80'. The kicked-up rear leg drops into a driving back lunge (foot 0.64 -> 0.32 m high, knee pole down) and the camera turns 50 -> 35 deg so the rear leg reads behind her instead of splayed sideways. The stamp itself (planted glaive, front heel) is unchanged.
why.hand: Critics (body 6, grip 8): 'the free hand is a clump at the sternum; move it to the hip, back of the wrist on the hip bone, elbow out'. The figure-pose lane's rest-frame wrist [-0.15, 0, 1.22] lands in front of the belly in the 45 deg view, under the cuff. Moved to [-0.21, 0.09, 1.10] (out, back and down onto the side of the hip) with the elbow pole out-back [-0.9, 1.0, 1.3]: the hand now sits on the silhouette's hip with the forearm and waist framing a gap (trials r2_vd / r2_ve, ve kept).
why.hair_volume: Critic (head and hair 4, round 2): 'the face sits large inside the hair; widen the hair mass so the face reads smaller'. Every hair clump except the five fringe clumps (04-08) and the cap is scaled x1.12 in x and y about the head's vertical axis at the crown (z 1.90), falling to x1.0 at z 1.45 (the tail is untouched). The circlet is built after this from the new contour.
why.haft: Critic (weapon 7): 'the shaft is a 3 px two-tone stick; thicken it to 4-5 px at 144'. The haft's rest mesh x1.25 in x and y about its own axis (x1.4 in trial R3a read as a heavy dark bar across N1).
why.idle_r3: Critic (posture 9): 'push the opposing shoulder tilt to about 10 degrees, arch the lumbar, lift the sternum'. Spine side tilt -22 -> -26 against the hips; chest -4 and upper chest -6 about x (a lift and an arch). Critic (arms 6): 'push the hip-hand elbow out to open a negative-space triangle; move the glaive hand up the haft toward the disc and off the bust line': the near arm's pole goes out-back [-1.2, 0.9, 1.2]; the glaive hand's slide 0.27 -> 0.36.
why.back_r3: Critics (posing 10, face 2): round 2's look 0.62 turned her face into profile away from the viewer and read as a scowl; 'turn the face three-quarters toward the camera over the shoulder, sweep the hair tail to the far side'. Look amount 0.75, max 75 (0.85 in trial r3_t1 read near-frontal); the back hair and tail chains blown harder to the far side (wind +X 2.0-2.2, g 0.15-0.2).
why.q_r3: Critics (posing 10, first impression): 'Q is a splayed high side-kick with the crotch toward the camera and a vertical glaive covering her body; a planted lean, glaive 15-35 degrees off the body'. The kicked rear foot is planted behind the front leg on its ball (0.55 m back, crossing to x 0.02, pitch 40), knee pole back; the hips rise 7 cm (loc z -0.37 -> -0.30) so the stance is a lean, not a squat. The glaive's direction tilts about 10 degrees to her left ([0.18, 0.34, 0.93]) so the haft stands beside her face instead of through it. Trials: tilted to her right (r3_t1) the haft crossed her whole body; +0.5 (R3a) put the haft out of the hands' reach, so she no longer held it; the pose file's own direction (r3_qa) runs the haft through her body; +0.18 (r3_qb) keeps both hands on it and clears the face. 15-35 degrees is not reachable with this grip.
